design_parameters.name: C-1 mounting location
design_parameters.value: central, on the thruster axis inside the inner magnetic core (option L-CENTRAL); L-EXTERNAL retained as the alternative
design_parameters.source: HOFER2008 pp. 2008-2009 (internal cathode improved coupling voltage by 5-10 V vs external; 6-11 V in the Jameson 6-kW study quoted there; centerline mounting 'favors the improved coupling'), pp. 2007, 2010-2011 (more collimated, symmetric plume), p. 2012 (drawbacks)
design_parameters.note: choice inferred from analog practice; magnitudes are not transferable (8-kW Xe device). Owner question H22-OQ-01; feasibility PENDING H2-1 inner-core bore

design_parameters.name: C-1 axis orientation
design_parameters.value: parallel to the thrust axis
design_parameters.source: HOFER2008 p. 2006 ('The major axis of both cathodes was aligned parallel with the thrust axis')

design_parameters.name: C-1 orifice axial position relative to the H-1 exit plane / inner pole
design_parameters.source: HOFER2008 p. 2006 (analog: internal cathode 'slightly recessed upstream of a hollow section of the inner magnetic pole')
design_parameters.note: needs the H-1 inner pole geometry and B map; fixed and recorded once chosen (HW-C1-01)

design_parameters.name: inner-core bore diameter needed for L-CENTRAL
design_parameters.value: >= C-1 keeper OD + radial clearance
design_parameters.source: IEPC2015_43 p. 4 (analog keeper OD about 3.0 cm for the 1.5-cm JPL cathode); SITAEL HC1/HC3 keeper OD not stated (IEPC2017_365)
design_parameters.note: keeper OD TBD - requires the C-1 selection (HWQ-09); clearance TBD - requires H2-1/H2-5

design_parameters.name: cathode service-line routing for L-CENTRAL
design_parameters.value: heater, keeper, cathode-common, thermocouple leads and the Xe line exit through the rear of the inner core; they must pass the pre-ionizer module slot between IP-UP and IP-DN without changing with the module and without crossing HALL_INLET_Z0
design_parameters.source: docs/experiments/hardware/hardware_requirements_v1.json HW-C1-01, HW-C1-04, HW-PIM-01 (summary section 0), HW-SVC-01
design_parameters.note: interface demand to the pre-ionizer module ICD (A6)

design_parameters.name: shielding / isolation concept of the emitter
design_parameters.value: S1 Xe flows whenever the emitter is hot and O2 may be present; S2 Xe purge before heating (XE_PURGE -> CATHODE_CONDITIONING); S3 keeper encloses the orifice and shields it from back-ion bombardment; S4 O-compatible keeper/orifice-plate material; S5 emitter kept at or above the reported O2-tolerance temperature during O-bearing operation
design_parameters.source: docs/experiments/hardware/hardware_requirements_v1.json HW-C1-03; schemas/controls/dual_feed_state_machine_v1.json states; IEPC2015_43 p. 2 (keeper protects the orifice plate from back-ion bombardment); IEPC2017_365 p. 3; DOSSIER lab6.env.o2_withstand_1570C
design_parameters.note: S1-S3 are adopted requirements/practice; S4-S5 are PROPOSED design rules of this lane

design_parameters.name: emitter temperature floor during O-bearing operation (PROPOSED design rule)
design_parameters.source: DOSSIER lab6.env.o2_withstand_1570C (G&K p. 306) and IEPC2015_43 p. 2: LaB6 at 1570 degC withstands O2 up to 1e-4 Torr without emission degradation
design_parameters.note: secondary statement of diode tests (level 5); O2 only - no atomic-O or N2 threshold exists (DOSSIER U04, U05); PROPOSED, not in the RFP

design_parameters.name: required attenuation of O from the local environment to the emitter
design_parameters.source: LANE19 required_attenuation(p_ext, p_tol); DOSSIER U03, G02
design_parameters.status: TBD - requires a measured emitter-region O/O2 tolerance (G02) and near-cathode partial pressures (RGA, HW-C1-07)

design_parameters.name: keeper / orifice-plate material
design_parameters.source: IEPC2015_43 p. 2 (analog keeper and orifice-plate materials: graphite); AOL5 evidence on graphite in O (RIT10 grid erosion higher on O2 than N2, attributed to O-graphite chemistry; MISSE 2 pyrolytic graphite AO erosion yield 4.15e-25 cm3/atom)
design_parameters.status: TBD - requires the C-1 selection and keeper-material coupon results (HW-C1-06)
design_parameters.note: graphite keepers are standard on Xe but carry a published O-chemistry warning; owner question H22-OQ-07

design_parameters.name: magnetic-field magnitude at the C-1 orifice
design_parameters.source: HOFER2008 p. 2012 (analog: the centerline region has an axially diverging field of the order of the peak channel field, 100-300 G)
design_parameters.note: value comes from the MC-1 design and the M0 B-map at the actual coil currents (HW-MC-03)

design_parameters.name: magnetic-field orientation at the C-1 orifice
design_parameters.value: axial (parallel to the cathode axis) for L-CENTRAL; set by the local field line for L-EXTERNAL
design_parameters.source: HOFER2008 p. 2007 (internal cathode plume 'compressed and elongated in the axial direction by the axial magnetic field emanating from the inner magnetic circuit'); IEPC2015_43 p. 4 (solenoid gives 'an adjustable axial magnetic field at the cathode exit to simulate that found on axis' of HERMeS)

design_parameters.name: allowed field magnitude at emitter and keeper
design_parameters.source: no accessed source states a limit; G&K p. 313 (ionization instabilities in the cathode plume can be inhibited by gas flow and/or the applied axial field): the field is a functional parameter of the cathode, not only an interference
design_parameters.status: TBD - requires C-1 characterization inside the MC-1 field at the operating coil currents (S1a) and the H2-1 field at the cathode location

design_parameters.name: ferromagnetic-free zone around C-1 and its mount
design_parameters.value: no ferromagnetic conductor, fastener or structure near MC-1 unless the model and M0/M0b map show it within INV-B3
design_parameters.source: docs/experiments/hardware/hardware_requirements_v1.json HW-MC-12
design_parameters.note: C-1 tube/flange/heat-shield materials must be declared magnetically (analog JPL: Mo tube, Ta foil, graphite; IEPC2015_43 pp. 2-3)

design_parameters.name: LaB6 emitter operating temperature (reported/derived span)
design_parameters.source: see derived.emitter_temperature_points (G&K p. 254; IEPC2015_43 p. 1; IEPC2017_365 p. 2; DOSSIER Joussot; LANE19 Lafferty table)
design_parameters.note: span of cited points for other hardware; the C-1 value depends on its emission current density; C-1 tube temperature is measured (HW-C1-09), emitter temperature only with a pyrometer view

design_parameters.name: emitter temperature reached before ignition
design_parameters.source: IEPC2017_365 p. 5 (about 1460 K); DOSSIER lab6.t.joussot_preheat (about 1420 degC)

design_parameters.name: heater power during preheat (analog envelope)
design_parameters.source: IEPC2017_365 p. 5 (45 W / 60 W, HC1); IEPC2015_43 p. 3 (120 W routinely, H6 LaB6; up to 300 W for the 1.5-cm cathode); DOSSIER lab6.start.joussot_heater_ignition (184.5 W), lab6.start.zsch_heater_max (up to 400 W, non-optimized)
design_parameters.note: C-1 value TBD - requires the C-1 selection; a start-phase load on cathode_heater

design_parameters.name: steady heater power
design_parameters.value: 0 W if C-1 self-heats at the lowest H-1 operating I_d; otherwise the maintained heater power of the selected unit (analog 185 W below 5 A, Joussot)
design_parameters.source: LANE19 (G&K p. 337: heater off once the discharge runs); DOSSIER lab6.heater.joussot_maintained, lab6.heater.joussot_selfheat_current

design_parameters.name: conduction path C-1 -> H-1
design_parameters.value: thin refractory cathode tube -> base flange -> insulating ring -> H-1 inner core / back pole
design_parameters.source: IEPC2015_43 pp. 2-3 (tube 'sufficiently long and thin to minimize conduction of heat from the insert to the base plate'), p. 4 (flange 'insulated from the thruster body by a Macor-ceramic ring'; flight: brazed assembly)

design_parameters.name: analog mounting-interface temperature
design_parameters.source: IEPC2017_365 p. 5 (HC1 thermal test: interface about 500 K, keeper about 600 K at about 20 W heater power; emitter about 1250 K)
design_parameters.note: one analog point at low heater power; not a C-1 boundary condition

design_parameters.name: radiation path C-1 -> inner magnetic circuit
design_parameters.value: heat shields around the heater (analog about ten turns of Ta foil) + an inner-coil hot-spot check against the coil insulation class
design_parameters.source: HOFER2008 p. 2012 (internal mounting 'can potentially lead to overheating of the thruster's inner magnetic circuit due to radiation from the hot cathode insert'); IEPC2015_43 p. 3 (Ta foil heat shield); docs/experiments/hardware/hardware_requirements_v1.json HW-MC-07, HW-MC-08

design_parameters.name: keeper DC ignition voltage capability (PROPOSED)
design_parameters.source: IEPC2015_43 p. 4 (150 V applied to the keeper); G&K pp. 310-311 (standard DC keeper voltage 50-150 V; 100-500 V for larger-orifice LaB6 cathodes)
design_parameters.note: minimum capability; the C-1 value comes from its ignition test with heater (SITAEL HC1 45-50 V; HC3 < 300 V: IEPC2017_365 pp. 6, 8)

design_parameters.name: keeper pulse ignition capability (PROPOSED)
design_parameters.source: G&K pp. 310-311 ('To ensure reliable thruster ignition over life, it is standard to apply both a DC keeper voltage in the 50- to 150-V range and a pulsed keeper voltage in the 300- to 600-V range')

design_parameters.name: keeper current: ignition limit and continuous capability
design_parameters.source: IEPC2015_43 p. 4 (keeper current regulated to 2 A at ignition); IEPC2017_365 p. 8 (HC1 350 h endurance on MSHT100 with 0.5 A keeper); DOSSIER lab6.start.zsch_keeper_min (at least 3 A keeper for self-heating)

design_parameters.value: floating if C-1 self-heats at the operating I_d; current-carrying otherwise (steady cathode_keeper load)
design_parameters.source: IEPC2015_43 p. 4 (keeper off and floating above 10 A), p. 5 (below 5 A the cathode stopped unless keeper > 2 A); IEPC2017_365 pp. 8-9 (HC1 floating with HT100; keeper on with MSHT100 and with HC3 on HT100)
design_parameters.status: TBD - requires the C-1 self-heating current measured in S1a vs the H-1 I_d range

location_options.description: C-1 on the thruster axis inside the inner magnetic core, cantilevered from the back pole
location_options.published_practice: internally mounted cathodes on JPL/Busek high-power thrusters (BHT-8000 internal BaO; HERMeS on-axis LaB6 field simulated by a solenoid)
location_options.analog_label: ANALOG (8-kW BHT-8000 on Xe; 12.5-kW HERMeS cathode)
location_options.coupling_voltage: analog improvement of 5-10 V (BHT-8000, 8 kW) and 6-11 V (6-kW study quoted) vs external; the source attributes it to location, not emitter (HOFER2008 p. 2009)
location_options.plume_exposure: sits in the central region where the source notes a possible trap for low-energy ions and increased keeper erosion (HOFER2008 p. 2012); for ABEP those ions include N+, N2+, O+, O2+ (AOL-M05) - keeper erosion and O chemistry at the keeper are a C-1 test item
location_options.magnetic_field_at_orifice: axial, of the order of the peak channel field (analog 100-300 G, HOFER2008 p. 2012); predictable from the MC-1 design because it lies on the axis
location_options.thermal: radiates into the inner magnetic circuit (overheating risk, HOFER2008 p. 2012) -> heat shields and an inner-coil hot-spot check (H2-5, HW-MC-07/08)
location_options.mechanical: cantilever from the back pole: launch-vibration moment arm (HOFER2008 p. 2012) -> H2-7; needs an inner-core bore (H2-1)
location_options.experiment_identity: position cannot change with a module exchange; axisymmetric plume keeps the thrust vector on the axis for every arm
location_options.rear_interface: service lines leave through the rear axis, where the pre-ionizer module slot sits (IP-UP..IP-DN): routing must be designed into the module ICD

location_options.description: C-1 outside the outer pole, axis parallel to the thrust axis
location_options.published_practice: traditional external mounting (HOFER2008 p. 2006: 'typical of Hall thrusters with optimized cathode locations'); SITAEL HC1/HC3 coupled externally to HT100 (IEPC2017_365 pp. 7-9)
location_options.coupling_voltage: analog: larger coupling voltage (-15 to -22 V vs -10 to -13 V, HOFER2008 p. 2008)
location_options.plume_exposure: outside the beam; the external cathode's electrons form a 'halo' along field lines around the pole pieces (HOFER2008 p. 2007); inner-core erosion negligible (p. 2012)
location_options.magnetic_field_at_orifice: set by the fringing field at the chosen position; depends on the separatrix location (no accessed source for H-1) -> PENDING H2-1 map
location_options.thermal: decoupled from the inner coil; radiates to the outer pole and the spacecraft side
location_options.mechanical: bracket on the outer pole; no inner-core bore
location_options.experiment_identity: asymmetric near-field plume (HOFER2008 pp. 2009-2011) - identical in every arm, so a common-mode effect on R_arch
location_options.rear_interface: service lines stay clear of the pre-ionizer module slot

shielding_isolation.threat: A5 architecture-closing risk rank 3 ('Xe-fed cathode consumption and oxygen isolation', evidence RI-MASS-CATHODE-XE): O2/O from the thruster's own neutral efflux, back-flowing plume ions (N+, N2+, O+, O2+) and, on ground, the facility background; in flight the thruster faces the wake, so the ram-facing AO flux of lane 19 is an upper bound, not the local value (inferred; magnitude TBD)
concept: S1 Xe cathode flow on whenever the emitter is hot (HW-C1-03)
S3 keeper enclosing the orifice (physical and ion shield)
S4 O-compatible keeper/orifice-plate/insulator materials (TBD, coupons HW-C1-06)
S5 emitter at or above 1843 K (1570 degC) during O-bearing operation (PROPOSED, H22-07)
S6 no emitter heating while O2 is in the chamber without Xe flow; exposure log (AOL-CX-05)

must_be_demonstrated.what: C-1 emission, keeper and coupling voltage stay within a pre-registered drift band over the O-bearing Phase-1 hours (daily Xe reference, AOL-CX-01)
near-cathode O2 / H2O / N2 partial pressures logged during O-bearing operation (RGA sampling port, HW-C1-07 / AOL-CX-03), as the proxy for the emitter-region environment (G02)

spot-mode minimum Xe flow vs emission current measured on C-1 in the H-1 field with an atmospheric anode feed (A5 risk 3, G06); poisoning can enlarge the plume-mode region (Suzuki 2024 abstract via LANE19)
restart after O-bearing operation succeeds within the keeper capability (start log AOL-CX-02)

shielding_isolation.not_demonstrable_on_ground_here: atomic-O exposure (no AO source in HW-ENV-07; HWQ-11) - flight transfer stays open (DOSSIER G02, G09)

flow_measurement.requirement: measure the C-1 Xe flow at the A5 design target 0.10 mg/s and the upper test point 0.15 mg/s, and step down to the spot-mode minimum, with an uncertainty small enough that the measured flow can be booked in the Xe ledger; the flow itself is NOT assumed (H4 output)
concept: two ranges: a precision cathode MFC (FS about 0.2 mg/s Xe) and a start-flow range (FS about 1 mg/s Xe)
calibrated on Xe, installed, at the operating inlet pressure and temperature (W4 INS-05)
reference conditions declared on every certificate (7.3 % trap between 0 and 20 degC references)
zero checked at the installed orientation and temperature before each block
flow_measurement.percent_of_reading_vs_full_scale: a % FS specification inflates the relative error as 1/Q: at 0.10 mg/s a 1 % FS device with FS 1.0 mg/s gives 10 % (0.54 kg over 15,000 h), the same class with FS 0.2 mg/s gives 2 %; a % Rd + % FS class gives 0.70 %

design_target.source: mdot / 0.0983009 mg/s per sccm (G&K App. B Eq. B-5 p. 464, 273.15 K / 1 atm; LANE19 parameters.xe_mg_s_per_sccm)

upper_test_point.source: mdot / 0.0983009 mg/s per sccm (G&K App. B Eq. B-5 p. 464, 273.15 K / 1 atm; LANE19 parameters.xe_mg_s_per_sccm)

cathode_xe_mass.note: 18,000 h is the A5 internal design-life target (sensitivity only; A5 books 15,000 h)

flow_measurement_uncertainty.relation: u_rel = rd_frac + fs_frac * FS / Q (specification form); zero terms added in quadrature: orientation 0.4 % FS and temperature 0.12 % FS/degC x dT (REF-SNYDER2017 via W4); u_m = u_rel x m_cathode(15,000 h), treated as fully correlated over the mission (a calibration bias does not average down)
flow_measurement_uncertainty.gas_conversion_note: every row assumes the instrument is calibrated ON XENON in its final configuration; a gas-conversion-factor (GCF) reading adds an uncertainty that no accessed source quantifies for Xe (REF-SNYDER2017 Table 2 covers Ar, He, SF6, C2F6, H2 only, per W4) -> TBD - requires a Xe calibration

reference_condition_mismatch.meaning: a flow unit referenced to 20 degC read as if referenced to 0 degC (or the reverse) is off by this factor (~7.3 %); the MFC certificate's standard/normal reference conditions must be declared and converted explicitly (G&K Eq. B-5 uses 273.15 K / 1 atm)

gravimetric_calibration.relation: m_min = sqrt(2) * u_balance / u_target (two weighings, balance term only; buoyancy, line-volume and temperature corrections come on top); duration = m_min / Q
gravimetric_calibration.axes_note: u_balance values are a parametric axis (assumed), not a statement about any balance; a heavy Xe bottle on a high-capacity balance usually has a coarser readability - the bottle mass sets the achievable u_balance (TBD - requires the calibration-rig design, H2-6)

rate_of_rise_check.relation: dp/dt = Q R_s T / V, R_s = R / M_Xe (M_Xe = 131.293 g/mol, G&K App. B)
rate_of_rise_check.axes_note: volume and temperature are example axes (assumed); u(Q)^2 = u(V)^2 + u(T)^2 + u(dp/dt)^2 in relative terms

preheat_purge_xe.relation: Xe per start = t_preheat x mdot_purge (HW-C1-03 rule: the emitter is heated only under Xe flow) ; mission = Xe per start x N_starts

cases.source: IEPC2017_365 p. 5 (60 W -> about 200 s to about 1460 K emitter)
IEPC2017_365 p. 5 (45 W -> about 1460 K in about 600 s)
IEPC2015_43 p. 4 ('cathode heater turned on for about 20 minutes'; heater power up to 300 W capability, p. 3; the power used is not stated)

preheat_purge_xe.N_starts_source: docs/budgets/xe_ledger/xe_ledger_v1.json scenarios SC-1 (nominal_restart) / SC-2 (heavy_restart: one start per orbit over 26,000 h at 180 km); scenario values, not allocations
preheat_purge_xe.finding: the preheat time is set by the C-1 heater design; under the purge-while-hot rule it converts directly into Xe per start. Heater power (start-phase bus peak, H2-4) trades against Xe per start (Xe ledger m_startup); with per-orbit restarts this term can reach the kg class

emission_current_upper_bounds.relation: I_d <= P / V_d with all of P in the discharge (bound only; the real I_d is lower and is an H-1 measurement). I_emit = I_d + I_keeper + I_interstage (G&K Eqs. 7.2-24/25 p. 339; LANE19)
emission_current_upper_bounds.P_source: docs/experiments/hardware/hardware_requirements_v1.json rfp_basis.power_max_W; A5 allocations_and_requirements 'bus-power design allocation <= 1.30-1.35 kW'

checked.finding: at analog scale a 30 mm keeper fits inside an 80 mm inner channel-wall diameter (ECHT OD 100 mm, width 10 mm); the real check is PENDING H2-1

checked.item: cathode Xe mass vs the 40 kg requirement
checked.finding: the A5 design term 0.10 mg/s gives 5.4 kg (13.5 %); analog diode minimum flows (0.6 mg/s at 2.5-4 A) would give 81 % but belong to other hardware and are not verdict-bearing (veto layer RI-MASS-CATHODE-XE straddles); closes only by measurement (A7 blocker 3)
0.02-0.18 g per start for the analog preheat times at 0.10-0.15 mg/s; kg-class only with per-orbit restarts (N_starts is TBD) - a design driver for fast preheat, not an incompatibility
no atomic-O or N2 threshold exists (NO_QUANTITATIVE_EVIDENCE); O2 evidence tolerates up to 1e-4 Torr at 1570 degC; cannot be refuted or confirmed without test
no accessed source gives a limit; axial fields of 100-300 G on axis are standard analog practice
floating cathode common with a resistor tie is published flight practice

checked.item: emission range vs analog cathode classes
checked.finding: the H-1 envelope (bound 8.33 A at 180 V, unknown low end) straddles published classes (SITAEL HC3 1-3 A design; JPL 1.5-cm needs >= 7.5 A without keeper; Joussot self-heats from 5 A): a steady keeper or heater load may be needed at the low end - a bus cost to carry, not a veto
catalog-class instruments with Xe calibration reach < 1 % (1 sigma treated) at FS 0.2 mg/s; measurable

architecture_changing_blockers_touched.how: direct: defines the flow-measurement capability for the 0.10-0.15 mg/s measurement, the spot-mode minimum-flow search (D-CX-03), the purge-while-hot Xe per start and the O-isolation demonstrations (D-CX-01..05); no value is closed here

architecture_changing_blockers_touched.text: Hall-only sustainment at the actual atmospheric feed state
architecture_changing_blockers_touched.how: indirect: C-1 is identical in every arm; Phase-1 extinction records must separate cathode-limited (plume-mode, keeper oscillation) from discharge extinctions (AOL-CX-06) so that a cathode limit is never read as a sustainment limit

architecture_changing_blockers_touched.text: incremental RF/ECR benefit after full bus-power accounting
architecture_changing_blockers_touched.how: indirect: cathode_keeper and cathode_heater are common bus components; if an arm's I_d falls below the C-1 self-heating current a steady keeper load appears in that arm only (LANE19) - measured per arm, never assumed

milestone.A: supported: C-1 integration is conditionally closable - 'the architecture holds provided C-1 sustains spot mode at <= the Xe flow the ledger can afford, keeps its emission/keeper drift inside the pre-registered band under O-bearing operation, and restarts within the keeper capability'
